edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Chronic periodontal inflammation may impair endothelial function systemically, offering a plausible vascular link to erectile dysfunction.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2018 Kellesarian systematic review in Am J Mens Health, which ties periodontal disease to erectile dysfunction in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
